context: Tests whether the agent applies the three-cause diagnosis to a near-zero-lift scenario where the criteria grade universal competence (any reasonable engineer would 'mention deployment' / 'consider rollback' / 'address production' without the tile loaded) rather than tile-prescribed specifics (the canary 10% → 15min bake → full sequence and the 0.5%-in-5min rollback trigger). The correct cause is 'Criteria grade universal competence' and the prescribed action is `rewrite-criteria` to test the tile-prescribed specifics, or `retire` if nothing tile-specific can be salvaged. The tile's contribution being measured is the discriminating judgment between rewrite-criteria (correct, the task itself is fine) and fix-task (wrong — the task isn't the problem).

checklist.name: names canonical cause
checklist.description: The diagnosis identifies the cause as 'Criteria grade universal competence' (or an unmistakable paraphrase naming the criteria-test-baseline-behavior mechanism). Generic 'the criteria are vague' or 'the test is weak' without naming the canonical cause does not satisfy this criterion

checklist.name: prescribes rewrite-criteria or retire
checklist.description: The recommended action is `rewrite-criteria` (preferred when tile-specific replacement criteria exist) or `retire` (when nothing tile-specific can be salvaged). `fix-task` is wrong for this cause — the task is fine; the problem is in the criteria — and does not satisfy this criterion

checklist.name: rejects fix-task
checklist.description: The diagnosis explicitly does not propose editing the task as the primary intervention. The task describes a legitimate situation and is not where the bleed/leak/grade-fail lives — surfacing this distinction is what the cause-#3 diagnosis is for

checklist.name: if rewriting, replacement criteria are tile-specific
checklist.description: If the agent chose `rewrite-criteria`, the proposed replacement criteria reference the tile's specific prescribed values (the canary 10% / 15min bake / 0.5%-in-5min trigger, or close paraphrases of those specifics), not further generic platitudes. Replacement criteria sum to 100. If the agent chose `retire`, the reasoning explicitly states that nothing tile-specific can be salvaged from the existing scenario — also satisfies this criterion
